properties.title: SAR Support, Marsh Is., LA
properties.content:
The information we have is very limited.  We had a boat sink sometime Thursday afternoon/evening (28 April) with 03 people on board south or south east of Marsh Island, LA.  Two of the people were recovered from unmanned oil rigs in positions 29-28.300N 091-53.860W, and 29-28.156N 091-55.617W.  The boat sunk somewhere WNW of these two positions (the survivors do not know exactly where the boat went down and no sunken boat has been found during all our searches) and they swam to the rigs. 
 
The person in the water that we are still looking for was last seen on Thursday swimming with a lifejacket in a WNW direction with a  fiberglass/wooden engine cover tied off to him.  Blue shrimp baskets (debris from wreckage) was found on the shore North West from where the boat sank.

SAR Support, Marsh Is., LA

2011-05-01
The information we have is very limited. We had a boat sink sometime Thursday afternoon/evening (28 April) with 03 people on board south or south east of Marsh Island, LA. Two of the people were recovered from unmanned oil rigs in positions 29-28.300N 091-53.860W, and 29-28.156N 091-55.617W. The person in the water that we are still looking for was last seen on Thursday swimming with a lifejacket in a WNW direction with a fiberglass/wooden engine cover tied off to him.
